stem:
Ishaan measures three glasses of warm milk. Glass P reads 52 °C. Glass Q reads 41 °C. Glass R reads 58 °C. Glass Q looks the creamiest.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Glass R is hotter than Glass P because 58 °C is higher than 52 °C.
Glass Q is hotter than Glass R because Glass Q looks the creamiest.
Glass P is colder than Glass R because 52 °C is lower than 58 °C.

teacher.key_rationale: Hotter and colder are decided by the temperature readings. Statements 1 and 3 follow the readings. Statement 2 wrongly uses creaminess instead of temperature.
